introduction: Migration of agent-fox CLI commands, pipeline runners, and internal input utilities from internal/ghapi to the forge-neutral issuex package, enabling full issue and pull request workflows across GitHub and GitLab.

glossary.Forge: A web-based service hosting Git repositories, issue tracking, and code review workflows, such as GitHub or GitLab.
glossary.ForgeClient: The unified Go interface declaring forge-neutral repository, issue, and pull request operations.
glossary.IssueRef: A reference identifying an issue or pull request within a repository by number.
glossary.KindIssue: The forge-neutral toolio input source classification indicating that the input originates from an issue or pull/merge request thread.
glossary.MultiSegmentRepo: A repository path with multiple hierarchical namespace components, such as nested GitLab subgroups (e.g., group/subgroup/project).
glossary.NoOpClient: An issuex client implementation used when no forge is configured, enabling offline file and text processing without network or credential requirements.

requirements.title: toolio Input Resolution and Forge-Neutral Issue Parsing
requirements.rationale: Tool input resolution must uniformly recognize and fetch issue and pull/merge request threads across both GitHub and GitLab forges.

criteria.action: define KindIssue SourceKind as "issue" and update Input struct fields to reference *issuex.IssueRef and *issuex.IssueThread

criteria.condition: Resolve is called with an argument string matching a GitHub or GitLab issue or pull/merge request URL
criteria.action: parse the argument via issuex.ParseIssueURL and retrieve the issue thread using the provided issuex.Client

criteria.condition: Resolve receives an issue URL when the provided issuex.Client is nil
criteria.action: reject the request with an error indicating no forge client is configured
criteria.contract: returns an error stating cannot read issue: no forge client configured

criteria.condition: forge.ReadIssue returns an HTTP 404 not found error and forge.Authenticated() is false
criteria.action: return an error wrapping the underlying failure and stating that the repository or issue may be private and require credentials
criteria.contract: returns an error annotating that credentials may be required for private access

criteria.condition: forge.ReadIssue succeeds for a recognized issue reference
criteria.action: set ref.IsPullRequest to true if thread.Issue.IsPR is true, truncate the rendered thread at MaxInputBytes, and return an Input with Kind KindIssue, Origin ref.URL(), Body set to truncated text, Truncated set to cut or thread.Truncated, Issue pointing to ref, and Thread pointing to thread

requirements.title: toolio Thread Rendering and Prompt Generation
requirements.rationale: Models consuming issue threads require deterministic prompt structures with platform-accurate branding and comment histories.

criteria.condition: RenderThread is called with an IssueRef whose Repo.Host contains "gitlab"
criteria.action: render the header line prefixed with "GitLab ", followed by "pull request" or "issue", ref.String(), and "(state: <state>)"

criteria.condition: RenderThread is called with an IssueRef whose Repo.Host contains "github" or is empty
criteria.action: render the header line prefixed with "GitHub ", followed by "pull request" or "issue", ref.String(), and "(state: <state>)"

criteria.condition: RenderThread is called with an IssueRef whose Repo.Host is non-empty and contains neither "gitlab" nor "github"
criteria.action: render the header line prefixed with "Forge ", followed by "pull request" or "issue", ref.String(), and "(state: <state>)"
for any issue thread rendered by RenderThread, format Title, Author, optional Labels, trimmed issue body, and sequential "--- comment by <login> ---" comment blocks in deterministic order

criteria.condition: RenderThread formats an IssueThread
criteria.action: append "\n[... further comments not read ...]\n" to the rendered thread text

requirements.title: toolio App Shell and Client Factory Integration
requirements.rationale: The tool application shell must automatically instantiate and configure the appropriate forge client or fallback no-op client based on input arguments and repository remotes.

criteria.action: define the Forge field of type issuex.Client on the Deps struct, replacing GitHub *ghapi.Client

criteria.condition: App.execute receives an argument recognized by issuex.ParseIssueURL with a non-empty Repo.Host
criteria.action: instantiate an issuex.Client via issuex.NewWithOptions targeting the parsed host URL and tool user agent

criteria.condition: the argument is not an issue URL or host-specific client creation returns an error
criteria.action: construct the forge client via issuex.New with tool user agent, falling back to issuex.NewNoOp() if construction returns an error

criteria.condition: Resolve completes successfully
criteria.guard: in.Thread is non-nil and in.Thread.CommentsErr is non-nil
criteria.action: record a warning on e.run with format "the issue's comments could not be read: %v"

criteria.condition: App.execute invokes a.Exec
criteria.action: pass the resolved forge client in Deps.Forge

requirements.title: Codefix Pipeline Runner Migration
requirements.rationale: The codefix pipeline must execute repository detection, credential validation, pull request landing, and issue comment updates using forge-neutral interfaces.

criteria.action: define Options with Repo issuex.Repo and Forge issuex.Client, define CategoryForge as "forge" with CategoryGitHub aliased to CategoryForge, and type alias issueRef to *issuex.IssueRef

criteria.condition: preflight executes
criteria.action: detect repository using issuex.DetectRepo(o.Workspace.Root), falling back to o.Input.Issue.Repo if o.Input.Issue is present

criteria.condition: preflight executes with o.DryRun false, unauthenticated o.Forge, and either o.Input.Issue is non-nil or o.Land is LandPR
criteria.action: return an auth failure specifying GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN, or GITLAB_TOKEN
criteria.contract: returns a Failure with stage "preflight" and category "auth" stating credentials are required

criteria.condition: preflight executes with o.Land as LandPR, o.DryRun false, and target repository invalid after remote detection
criteria.action: return a usage failure explaining that --land=pr needs a target repository
criteria.contract: returns a Failure with stage "preflight" and category "usage" explaining origin remote or issue URL requirement

criteria.condition: openPullRequest executes with valid target repository
criteria.action: call o.Forge.CreatePullRequest with Title, Body, Head, Base, and Draft parameters, recording returned URL and Number in result

criteria.condition: postComment executes with o.Input.Issue non-nil
criteria.action: call o.Forge.AddComment with the target issue reference and comment body, appending the returned comment URL to result.Comments

requirements.title: Codeimpl Pipeline Runner Migration
requirements.rationale: The codeimpl pipeline must validate target repository and forge authentication before landing pull requests through issuex.

criteria.action: define Options with Repo issuex.Repo and Forge issuex.Client, and define CategoryForge as "forge" with CategoryGitHub aliased to CategoryForge

criteria.condition: preflight runs with target repository unspecified
criteria.action: resolve the target repository using issuex.DetectRepo(st.root)

criteria.condition: preflight runs with o.Land as LandPR, o.DryRun false, and o.Forge unauthenticated
criteria.action: return an auth failure stating that --land=pr needs GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN, or GITLAB_TOKEN
criteria.contract: returns a Failure with stage "preflight" and category "auth"

criteria.condition: preflight runs with o.Land as LandPR, o.DryRun false, and target repository invalid
criteria.action: return a usage failure indicating that the repository root has no origin remote on a recognized forge
criteria.contract: returns a Failure with stage "preflight" and category "usage"

criteria.condition: codeimpl lands changes via LandPR
criteria.action: call o.Forge.CreatePullRequest with target repository, title, body, head branch, base branch, and draft flag, populating result.PullRequestURL and result.PullRequestNumber upon success

requirements.title: Issuetriage Pipeline Runner Migration
requirements.rationale: The issuetriage pipeline must inspect credentials and perform issue creation and updating against any supported forge through issuex.

criteria.action: define Options with Repo issuex.Repo and Forge issuex.Client, and define CategoryForge as "forge" with CategoryGitHub aliased to CategoryForge

criteria.condition: resolveTarget executes with o.Repo unset, o.Input.Issue unset, o.DryRun false, and issuex.DetectRepo failing to find an origin remote
criteria.action: return a usage failure explaining that no origin remote exists on a recognized forge
criteria.contract: returns a Failure with stage "preflight" and category "usage" naming --repo and --dry-run

criteria.condition: checkWriteCredential executes when o.Forge is nil
criteria.action: return an internal failure indicating no forge client is configured
criteria.contract: returns a Failure with stage "preflight" and category "internal"

criteria.condition: checkWriteCredential executes when o.Forge is unauthenticated and o.DryRun is false
criteria.action: return an auth failure stating that the action in target needs GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN, or GITLAB_TOKEN
criteria.contract: returns a Failure with stage "preflight" and category "auth"

criteria.condition: write executes
criteria.action: call o.Forge.UpdateIssue with o.Input.Issue reference, updating title and body, and populate result with the issue URL and Number

criteria.condition: write executes
criteria.action: call o.Forge.CreateIssue with target repository, title, body, and labels, and populate result with the created issue URL and Number

criteria.condition: write encounters an error from o.Forge
criteria.action: classify the error via issuex.IsNoToken to return an auth failure if true or a CategoryForge failure otherwise
criteria.contract: returns a Failure with stage "write" and category "auth" when token is missing or "forge" for other forge errors

requirements.title: Specgen Pipeline Runner Migration
requirements.rationale: The specgen pipeline must validate forge credentials and post PRD feedback comments to issues across GitHub and GitLab via issuex.

criteria.action: define Options with Forge issuex.Client, replacing GitHub *ghapi.Client

criteria.condition: specgen executes preflight with o.Comment true, o.DryRun false, and o.Forge is nil or unauthenticated
criteria.action: return an auth failure stating that --comment needs a forge credential: set GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN, or GITLAB_TOKEN, or run without --comment
criteria.contract: returns a Failure with stage "preflight" and category "auth"

criteria.condition: specgen finishes generating a PRD with o.Comment true and o.DryRun false
criteria.action: post the PRD content as an issue comment via o.Forge.AddComment

criteria.condition: o.Forge.AddComment fails while posting the PRD comment
criteria.action: record a warning on o.Run without failing the pipeline execution
criteria.contract: o.Run records the warning while the pipeline returns a successful Result

requirements.title: CLI Commands Migration
requirements.rationale: Command line interfaces must parse repository flags with multi-segment path support, pass forge clients to pipeline runners, and display updated forge-neutral help text.

criteria.condition: cmd/fix parses a non-empty --repo flag
criteria.action: validate and parse the repository identifier using issuex.ParseRepo, pass Forge: d.Forge to codefix.Options, and describe GitHub and GitLab issue and pull/merge-request URLs in usage text

criteria.condition: cmd/impl parses a non-empty --repo flag
criteria.action: validate and parse the repository identifier using issuex.ParseRepo, pass Forge: d.Forge to codeimpl.Options, and document forge options in usage text

criteria.condition: cmd/issue parses a non-empty --repo flag
criteria.action: validate and parse the repository identifier using issuex.ParseRepo, pass Forge: d.Forge to issuetriage.Options, and update usage and preflight text to refer to forge issue URLs

criteria.condition: cmd/spec executes
criteria.action: pass Forge: d.Forge to specgen.Options, and document GitHub and GitLab issue URLs in usage text

criteria.condition: cmd/fix, cmd/impl, or cmd/issue receives a malformed --repo flag that issuex.ParseRepo fails to parse
criteria.action: reject the execution with a usage error
criteria.contract: returns a usage error indicating the repository flag cannot be parsed

requirements.title: Deprecation and Compatibility Layer for internal/ghapi
requirements.rationale: Deprecation notices and type forwarding in internal/ghapi preserve backwards compatibility for unmigrated branches while directing callers to issuex.

criteria.action: include standard Go deprecation comments referencing github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentfox/issuex in package-level documentation
alias Repo to issuex.Repo and IssueRef to issuex.IssueRef with deprecation notices
forward ParseRepo, ParseRemote, DetectRepo, and ParseIssueURL to their issuex equivalents with deprecation notices
retain Client methods in internal/ghapi/client.go annotated with deprecation notices for backwards compatibility

requirements.title: Test Suite Migration and Verification
requirements.rationale: Automated test suites must verify forge interactions against mock HTTP servers using issuex clients across GitHub and GitLab scenarios.

criteria.condition: input resolution tests run in internal/toolio
criteria.action: verify that both GitHub and GitLab issue and pull/merge-request URLs resolve to KindIssue with parsed IssueRef metadata matching the URL using issuex clients

criteria.condition: thread rendering tests run in internal/toolio
criteria.action: verify deterministic thread text output including distinct headers for GitHub, GitLab, and other forge hosts

criteria.condition: pipeline tests run in codefix
criteria.action: verify pull request creation and issue comment operations using an issuex.Client connected to an HTTP test server

criteria.condition: triage tests run in issuetriage
criteria.action: verify new issue creation and existing issue update mutations using an issuex.Client connected to an HTTP test server
complete make test and make lint across all modified packages without errors or deprecation breakages

execution_paths.title: Triaging a GitLab issue via issue CLI

steps.action: invokes agent-fox issue with a GitLab issue URL (e.g., https://gitlab.com/group/subgroup/project/-/issues/42)
parses the GitLab URL, extracts gitlab.com host, and instantiates an issuex.Client for GitLab
invokes forge.ReadIssue to fetch the thread and constructs toolio.Input with KindKindIssue
formats the issue title, author, and comments prefixed with the GitLab branding header
executes diagnosis and updates the issue via forge.UpdateIssue or posts an issue comment

execution_paths.title: Fixing a bug and opening a GitHub pull request via fix CLI

steps.action: invokes agent-fox fix --land=pr with a GitHub issue URL and GITHUB_TOKEN configured
parses the GitHub URL, constructs a GitHub issuex.Client, and passes it in Deps.Forge
loads the GitHub issue thread via forge.ReadIssue
resolves target repository, checks credentials, pushes a fix branch, and calls forge.CreatePullRequest and forge.AddComment
receives JSON envelope containing the created pull request URL and issue comment link

execution_paths.title: Generating specifications with PRD feedback posted to a GitLab issue

steps.action: invokes agent-fox spec --comment with a GitLab issue URL and GITLAB_TOKEN configured
parses the issue URL and initializes an authenticated GitLab issuex.Client
generates specification artifacts and calls forge.AddComment to post the finished PRD back to the GitLab issue
receives the comment payload and appends the PRD markdown to the issue thread

execution_paths.title: Implementing a specification with pull request landing on a nested GitLab project

steps.action: invokes agent-fox impl --land=pr --repo gitlab-org/subgroup/repo targeting a spec directory
parses the multi-segment repository path via issuex.ParseRepo and validates options
verifies forge authentication, checks out branch, implements tasks, and calls forge.CreatePullRequest on the nested GitLab project
receives JSON envelope with merge request URL for the multi-segment repository
